beats.shot: extreme close-up, frozen shards in background
beats.action: finger over smooth wrist; glass frozen inches from Mia (recap visual)
beats.line: Fifteen years of saving.

beats.action: TAP 1
beats.line: One tap.

beats.action: rewind to Jace reaching for bottle
beats.line: Ten seconds back, before the pour.

beats.action: hero yells, Jace pours anyway
beats.line: I yelled. He poured anyway.

beats.action: TAP 2
beats.line: Tap.

beats.action: hero grabs Jace's arm
beats.line: I grabbed his arm.

beats.action: Jace shoves hero, pours
beats.line: He shoved me, and poured.

beats.action: TAP 3, knuckles wrinkle (aged_hands_3)
beats.line: Tap. My knuckles started to wrinkle.

beats.action: hero steps back, eyes narrow
beats.line: So I stopped fighting and started watching.

beats.action: water bottle highlighted left of acid
beats.line: Water bottle, left of the acid.

beats.action: Jace's right hand highlighted on pour
beats.line: He pours with his right hand.

beats.action: Jace turns away to pose, 7s mark
beats.line: At second seven, he turns to pose for his phone.

beats.action: TAP 4 (aged_hands_4)
beats.line: Tap. Last loop.

beats.action: hero waits, Jace turns his back
beats.line: I waited. He turned.

beats.action: phone flash; hero swaps bottle positions
beats.line: Flash. I swapped the bottles.

beats.action: clear water pours, nothing happens
beats.line: He poured water. Nothing happened.

beats.action: Jace frowns at his phone, retakes selfie, ignores the beaker
beats.line: Jace checked his selfie, never the beaker.

beats.action: hero tugs sleeves over aged hands
beats.line: I pulled my sleeves over my hands.

beats.action: Mia spots hero's aged hands under his sleeves
beats.line: Mia saw them anyway. "You never tap. Why now?"

beats.action: four-tap montage flash over hands
beats.line: Four taps. Four years.

beats.action: 10s counter ticks once
beats.line: For ten seconds.

beats.action: Mia's unhurt face fills frame, she smiles
beats.line: Mia smiled at me, her face perfect,

beats.action: Mia slides hero a pencil
beats.line: and lent me a pencil again.

beats.action: Jace taps wrist to redo a selfie, hands older
beats.line: Jace spends his years on selfies.

beats.action: grandma's trembling old hands
beats.line: Grandma spent hers on her own mistakes.

beats.action: hero's aged hands hold Mia's pencil, steady
beats.line: I spent mine on someone else.

beats.action: Mia laughs beside hero in golden light
beats.line: A few years of my hands for her whole face.

beats.shot: slow pull-back wide (mirrors Part 1 beat 1 framing)
beats.action: hand rests on wrist, no tap; fade
beats.line: They were saved for her.
